Product Resume Template

Input: A target JD, your actual education and experience, and verifiable artifacts.
Action: Select evidence for the role. Describe your actions, decisions and outcomes.
Output: A factually consistent resume with working links.
Acceptance: Dates, titles, contributions and numbers can be explained and checked.
If it fails: Clarify your contribution or improve the underlying work. Do not invent experience or metrics.

[Real full name]

[Email] · [Phone] · [City/time zone] · [Portfolio]

Education

[Real university] — [Actual degree and subject] | [Start]–[Expected/actual graduation]

[Relevant coursework or a real project.]

Experience

[Real employer] — [Actual title] | [Dates]

  • [Specific problem + your action + supporting reasoning + verifiable outcome].
  • [Collaboration or trade-off + your contribution + attribution boundary].

Remove this section if you do not have employment or internship history.

Product Projects

[Project] — [Course / Personal / Internship / Teaching Exercise] | [Dates]

  • [Who had what problem, and what evidence you used].
  • [Options you compared, your choice and its cost].
  • [What you completed, what happened, and what remains untested].

Teaching example, not the applicant's experience: Compared a spreadsheet workflow, rule-based checks and AI-assisted automation using six explicitly synthetic scenarios. Created a prototype and validation plan; no real-user study or live launch is claimed.

Skills and Languages

[Only capabilities and proficiency you can demonstrate.]
